title: Adopting a repository without tests creates a first task for one real test and refuses vacuous green
body:
Why: Fable plan 1114c #2. Swieta-na-starowce, 3d-wkladki, krn-zakupy report no test command; workspaces get npm test --workspaces --if-present (src/repo/contract.ts:154-159), which passes with zero tests.
Outcome: krn adopt on a repository whose test command is missing or runs zero tests writes a first tracker task 'one real test and a test command' and the contract marks the test command vacuous; the Stop gate and lane run refuse to treat a vacuous test command as green.
Proof: fixture tests for a no-test repository and a workspace with no tests; npm run fast PASS.
